title: Unlocking the Freedom of the Holy Ghost at The River Church
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner challenges us to pray for a breakthrough in our church, asking God to grip those who come through our doors and release the Holy Spirit's life-changing power. With a prophetic call to awaken to the supernatural, Pastor Chris reminds us that the Holy Ghost is real and still moving, and that we should never be ashamed to surrender to His presence. Join us as we pray for an open heaven and an increased hunger for the miraculous in our church.
